terms.headline: Payment Terms & Conditions
items: A payment made on a policy that has already been cancelled for non-payment will not reinstate the policy.
If you make a payment on a policy that is pending cancellation for non-payment, please contact our customer service department as soon as possible after paying.
Credit card payments may take up to 4 business days to process.
E-Check payments may take up to one week to process.
If your payment is rejected by your card issuer or bank, the policy will remain cancelled for non-payment. Peerless Brokerage is not responsible for any fees charged for rejected payments.
